snippet.title: Aurelune: Seven Eclipses | Official Trailer | Free JRPG (RPG Maker MZ)
snippet.description:
The world's crystals are going out, one by one. In the shadows, someone thinks that's absolutely brilliant.

Aurelune: Seven Eclipses is a free JRPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics, made with RPG Maker MZ. A runaway samurai prince, a Guardian who knows more than she says, an airship crew, and seven Eclipses who want the night to last forever.

- A full story in five acts, with a prologue and an epilogue
- Choose your hero: boy or girl, and their name
- ATB battles, a Limit gauge, and character commands
- Fourteen companions: change your party of four at any time
- Painted portraits, secrets, side quests, fishing, an arena
- English and French, keyboard and gamepad

PLAY IT FREE (Windows): https://bakabao.itch.io/aurelune
It is an alpha: bugs are expected. Report them on the BakaBaoTV Discord, with your version number.

If you enjoy it, you can support the project: https://ko-fi.com/bakabaotv

Made by BakaBaoTV. One hat, one crew, one legend.

Music: "Aurelune Theme" (AI-generated, edited by hand). Made with RPG Maker MZ. Full credits are in the game folder (CREDITS.txt).

#Aurelune #JRPG #RPGMaker #IndieGame #PixelArt
